Yes, we fight.

We argue. We say things we don't mean.
Sometimes the silence between us feels
louder than all our words.

And I know it's hard.
I know you wonder sometimes —
is this worth it?

🌹

But here's what I know.

No matter how many fights we have,
no matter how many walls go up between us —

I will always come back to you.

You are not just my girlfriend, Sanju.
You are my home.
And I will always be yours.
No matter what.

And you know why? 🥛

"Because I have first right on your milk — and no fight in the world is going to change that." 😂💕

Only we understand this. And that's exactly what makes us, us. 🤍

fights and all... forever? 💍
